title: Internal Help Capability: Agent Self-Navigation and Wheel Improvement
description: Help is an internal agent capability (not user-facing) that enables agents to discover local knowledge, navigate the wheel, and surface gaps. Questions that can't be answered locally create lugs that improve the wheel over time.
perceive: Agents working in spokes need to: (1) know what they know locally, (2) discover what exists in the wheel, (3) route questions efficiently, (4) surface gaps for improvement
execute: Implemented help as a Skill (framework/skills/help.yaml). Agents use it to navigate registry, find expertise, and identify shortcomings. No user-facing command.
verify: Help Skill enables feedback loop: agent finds gap → submits lug → receiver sees gap → improves
resolution_reason: Internal capability creates virtuous cycle: agents discover gaps → wheel improves → next agent has better knowledge
